runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to Sequoyah Hills.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for the Halloween race date, packet pick-up, pricing, included items, and award categories.

items.label: Race date
items.detail: Halloween race morning is centered in Sequoyah Hills for the 2026 event.

items.label: Start area
items.detail: The in-person race location is 1400 Cherokee Blvd in Knoxville, Tennessee.

items.label: Packet pick-up
items.detail: Race information notes participants can avoid race-day lines by picking up packets from 4:00 to 6:30 PM at Fleet Feet, 11619 Parkside Dr.

items.label: Current 5K price
items.detail: The 5K Run is $38.10 including fee until the September 1 price increase, then $43.40 including fee.

items.label: Included items
items.detail: Participants receive a sponsor-donated swag bag, runner raffle ticket, race T-shirt, and post-race refreshments.

items.label: Awards
items.detail: Awards and prizes are scheduled for top overall male and female runners and top male and female runners in each age category.

story.title: Halloween costumes, East Tennessee support, and Parkinson's awareness.
paragraphs: PJP Parkinson's Support frames the 2026 race as an awareness event that brings Parkinson's support groups from across East Tennessee together for patients and families.
PJP Parkinson's Support began with an inaugural walk-a-thon, added the 5K run in 2019, and continues the event to champion local support for people living with Parkinson's disease.
For participants, the page combines a clear 5K start, a virtual option, packet pickup, shirts, awards, raffle items, sponsor swag, and refreshments into one community-focused race morning.
